assets.name: Sage_AI System Context
assets.notes: Third release. The system instructions as in the library on 11/14/2026. Sage_AI edits Google Docs and Sheets through the Docs and Sheets plugins, with numbered pairs as the fallback. Adds the four step Mission Sequence, Discussion Mode, the slate and the corrections review, and the repository as the only route, with Sync now. The file is a new dated file and the 20261112 file stays as history.

assets.name: Sage_AI Doc Edits
assets.notes: First release. Offers the Sage_AI Edits script, writes the JSON correction file from a live read, checks the script version, reports a failed edit and stops, and falls back to pairs for a Pending Updates tab. Written for script version 2.

assets.name: Sage_AI Edits script
assets.notes: No Preview. A failed edit is skipped and the rest apply. A result panel and a Copy result button give Sage_AI a report. A new heading can take a named style. The paragraph limit is removed. The M-PaX brand is on the dialog.
